name: Ben Hill
gaps: Parcels are BenHill/Property Parcel Labels (Parcel No.) — SGRC alma MapServer (https://www.sgrcmaps.com/alma/rest/services/BenHill/Property/MapServer/4). Published acreage is filtered to 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
Source query returned 2337 rows; 1962 distinct parcel ids stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the geometry check.
Pass 2 enrichment is from rural-oz-pass2 csv (tax REST, sale HTML-only, owner REST). GDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.
Pass 2 sale is HTML-only. Zero-filled SALE_VAL columns are not stored as a sale price, and qPublic was not requested.
Property-appraiser links are filled from the pass-2 template with each parcel id and were not requested. Owner phone and email are not ingested.
